original.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying container image signatures that use the sigstore bundle format via the new verification type `SigstoreBundle`, enabling verification of GitHub Artifact Attestations (e.g. SLSA Provenance).

decision.reason: [ev-dc7503345583] says Kyverno 1.13 "introduces support for verifying container images signatures that use the sigstore bundle format" through verification type `SigstoreBundle`. That is a new signature-verification capability, so "added" is the right change type. Protocol-behavior (signing/verification) is a fitting family. The name "sigstore-bundle-verification" comes straight from the section heading. A crd-field subject would be more precise, but the excerpt cuts off before the policy and never shows the field path. The two rendered diffs [ev-ea3f83a6e087] and [ev-bcf9822c2eb4] cover Service appProtocol changes and have nothing to do with this feature.
